# BUG-Rows — Alternative Set (Families 9–14, MIT/Apache 2.0)

Real defects in config-driven admin platforms, schema-driven form engines,
modular commerce, headless UI engines, design systems, and plugin frameworks.
Format mirrors `new sets/BUG-Rows.md`. ID prefix `-A` distinguishes from the
original library.

```
Common coverage labels (file-constant):
  source_license_state     : external_license_checked
  contract_signature       : repair flow at sub-phase 4.5
  node_role                : node_05  (repair routing)
  pair_kind                : flow_node
```

---
